vocabulary.definition: The space inside a triangle. A triangle is half of a rectangle with the same base and height, so A = ½ × b × h.
vocabulary.definitionEs: El espacio dentro de un triángulo. Un triángulo es la mitad de un rectángulo con la misma base y altura, por eso A = ½ × b × h.

vocabulary.cloze: The space inside a triangle, found with A = ½ × b × h, is the ___.

vocabulary.definition: Any side of a triangle can be the base. Once you pick a base, the height must be measured perpendicular (at a 90° angle) to it.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Cualquier lado de un triángulo puede ser la base. Una vez que eliges la base, la altura debe medirse perpendicular (en un ángulo de 90°) a ella.

copyPanel.formula: Area = ½ × Base × Height (A = ½ b · h)
steps: 1. Identify the base and the perpendicular height to that base
2. A triangle is exactly half of a rectangle with the same base and height
3. Multiply base by height, then divide by 2

revealWordProblem.title: Apply: Painting a Cabin
revealWordProblem.text: The front of this A-frame cabin is a triangle with a base of 34 ft and a height of 23¾ ft. Find the area of the triangular front that needs to be painted.
revealWordProblem.imageAlt: A photograph of an A-frame cabin with its triangular front outlined, labeled 34 feet across the base and 23 and three-fourths feet for the height.
revealWordProblem.sampleAnswer: Area = ½ × base × height = ½ × 34 × 23¾. First, 23¾ = 23.75, so 34 × 23.75 = 807.5. Then take half: 807.5 ÷ 2 = 403.75. The triangular front of the cabin has an area of 403.75 square feet.

questions.stem: What is the area of a triangle with base 10 cm and height 6 cm?
questions.explanation: A = ½ × b × h = ½ × 10 × 6 = 30 square centimeters.
choiceFeedback: 16 comes from adding 10 + 6. Area means multiply the base and height, then take half.
The number is right, but cm measures length. Area needs square units (sq cm).
60 is base × height — the full rectangle. A triangle is half of that, so multiply by ½.
hints: You have a base of 10 cm and a height of 6 cm — a triangle needs only those two, plus one special step.
A triangle is half of a rectangle: use A = ½ × b × h. If you only multiply, your answer is twice too big.
Multiply 10 × 6, then take half of the product. Area units are square centimeters.
questions.stemEs: ¿Cuál es el área de un triángulo con base de 10 cm y altura de 6 cm?

questions.stem: A triangle has an area of 24 sq ft and a base of 8 ft. What is the height?
choiceFeedback: 3 is 24 ÷ 8 — but that skips the ½. Double the area first: 2 × 24 = 48, then divide by the base.
12 is half of 24 — that divides by 2 instead of doubling. Try 2 × 24 = 48, then ÷ 8.
16 comes from 24 − 8. Use h = (2 × area) ÷ base instead of subtracting.
hints: The area (24 sq ft) and base (8 ft) are given — you're solving backwards for the height.
Simplify first: ½ × 8 = 4, so the equation becomes 24 = 4 × h.
Divide 24 by 4 to find the height in feet.
questions.stemEs: Un triángulo tiene un área de 24 sq ft y una base de 8 ft. ¿Cuál es la altura?
hintsEs: Te dan el área (24 pies²) y la base (8 pies): estás despejando la altura al revés.
Simplifica primero: ½ × 8 = 4, así que la ecuación se vuelve 24 = 4 × h.
Divide 24 entre 4 para hallar la altura en pies.

questions.stem: Why do we divide by 2 when finding the area of a triangle?

The base is always twice the height
We always divide area formulas by 2
questions.explanation: A triangle with base b and height h fits inside a rectangle with the same base and height. The triangle covers exactly half the rectangle, so A = ½ × b × h.
choiceFeedback: Which two sides are parallel?
The height is perpendicular to them.

reviewHighlights.watchOut: A common mistake in Area of Triangles is forgetting the ½ — students multiply base × height like a rectangle and stop there, or they use the triangle's slanted side instead of the perpendicular height that's already given. level1.stem: (Lesson 5.3) What is the area of a trapezoid with bases 6 cm and 10 cm, and height 4 cm?
level1.explanation: Start with the formula: A = ½ × (b₁ + b₂) × h. Put in the numbers: ½ × (6 + 10) × 4. Add the bases first: ½ × 16 × 4. Multiply: 32 sq cm.
choiceFeedback: 24 is 6 × 4 — only one base was used. Add both bases first: 6 + 10 = 16.
40 is 10 × 4 — only the longer base. A trapezoid uses the average of BOTH bases.
64 is (6 + 10) × 4 without the ÷ 2. Take half of the bases' sum before multiplying by the height.
hints: A trapezoid has two bases (6 cm and 10 cm) plus a height (4 cm) — all three belong in the formula.
Use A = ½ × (b₁ + b₂) × h: add the bases first, then multiply by the height, then take half.
Add 6 + 10 to get the base sum, multiply that by 4, then cut the result in half.

level1.stem: (Lesson 5.3) A trapezoid has an area of 45 sq ft, bases of 7 ft and 11 ft. What is the height?
level1.explanation: Start with the formula: A = ½ × (b₁ + b₂) × h. Put in what you know: 45 = ½ × 18 × h. Simplify the right side: 45 = 9h. Divide both sides by 9: h = 5 ft.
choiceFeedback: Check it: (7 + 11) ÷ 2 × 3 = 27, not 45. Double the area first: 2 × 45 = 90, then ÷ 18.
Check it: (7 + 11) ÷ 2 × 10 = 90 — that's double the area. Divide 90 by 18, not by 9.
hints: You already know the area (45 sq ft) and both bases (7 ft and 11 ft) — the height is what's missing.
Simplify first: ½ × (7 + 11) = 9. So the equation becomes 45 = 9 × h.
Divide 45 by 9 to find the height in feet.

level2.prompt: A rectangle is 12 ft by 8 ft. A diagonal line cuts it into two triangles. What is the area of each triangle? Explain how the triangle area formula relates to the rectangle area formula.
level2.sentenceFrame: The rectangle's area is ___ because ___. Each triangle's area is ___ because a diagonal splits a rectangle into ___ equal triangles, so A = ½ × ___ × ___ = ___.
level2.hint: Write the formula with given numbers; solve step by step.
hints: Start with the rectangle: its area comes from 12 × 8. The diagonal splits that area into two identical pieces.
Each triangle keeps the same base (12) and height (8) as the rectangle — so its area is half the rectangle's.

level2.explanation: The rectangle's area is 12 × 8 = 96 sq ft, and one diagonal cuts it into two identical triangles, so each triangle is 96 ÷ 2 = 48 sq ft.
